simulatorProvisioning.runtime: the highest available iOS 26.x simulator runtime
simulatorProvisioning.procedure: Use only the manual ace-ios-live-evidence-manual workflow after approval. Pass the checked-out candidate SHA as --expected-commit. Bind the approved remote repository, clean Git tree, baseline ancestry, and exact executing Git head. Resolve one exact device type before device selection. Existing and created devices must have that type identifier and a canonical 36-character hyphenated hexadecimal UUID. Select the highest available iOS 26.x runtime before target resolution. Accept one exact available target only in that runtime. Use one 30-second monotonic deadline for creation and polling. Save only controlled simulator metadata, result bundles, summaries, logs, and checksums below the absolute external artifact root /private/tmp/mcx-19-live-evidence. Do not write raw artifacts or result claims to the repository.
simulatorProvisioning.failure: Fail when the expected commit is absent, invalid, or does not equal the executing Git head; the repository, baseline, or clean tree is invalid; the artifact root exists, is in the Git tree, uses a symlink, or escapes its root; the exact device type is absent or ambiguous; a matching device UUID is invalid; no available iOS 26.x runtime exists; highest-version selection is invalid or ambiguous; the selected runtime has multiple exact available targets; creation fails; a poll subprocess exceeds its remaining verification time; a UUID is duplicated; a result is non-zero, missing, skipped, failed, or has a wrong count; an artifact is missing; a checksum changes; or a secret or redaction check fails. Do not create the target again.

historicalCommitChain.note: Obsolete history is not a release or evidence control.

entries.procedure: Validate the approved remote, clean Git tree, baseline ancestry, and exact executing Git head. Write the identity only to the external controlled manifest.
entries.expectedResult: The external manifest binds the approved repository and exact executing Git head. Repository records remain pending.

entries.device: Approved signed iPhone with the approved access group
entries.procedure: Run the approved returned-attribute matrix. Cover every required inventory and exact-read attribute rule, including a valid signed access group.
entries.expectedResult: Each required inventory and exact-read attribute rule passes or enters deletion-only recovery as specified.

entries.device: Approved signed iPhone with the approved access group
entries.procedure: Store and load with the approved signed access group. Test a mismatched access group.
entries.expectedResult: The approved signed access group loads successfully. Mismatches fail closed.

entries.stage: Approved macOS with Xcode 26 and iOS 26 simulator runtime
entries.device: iPhone SE (3rd generation) with iOS 26; iPhone 16 Pro Max with iOS 26
entries.procedure: Run the existing controlled-scenario UI tests in light and dark appearance on both specified simulators. The tests run accessibility audits and the release orientation hook. An approved operator must run the pending orientation matrix for every other listed screen and state on both simulators. Run Dynamic Type, Bold Text, Reduce Motion, and Increase Contrast.
entries.expectedResult: The approved records must show the accessibility audit and release orientation hook. The manual orientation matrix remains pending until separately recorded.

entries.stage: Approved physical pilot validation after signing, device, and Security approvals
entries.device: Approved iPhone 15 Pro or later with iOS 26
entries.procedure: Run the locked-device, VoiceOver, and app-switcher journeys with fictional data only.
entries.expectedResult: Keychain access is unavailable while locked. VoiceOver order is correct. The app-switcher image contains no release information.

entries.stage: Approved controlled-evidence review after Pocock approval
entries.procedure: Inspect the approved evidence package for visible usernames, passwords, Authorization values, and Keychain secrets.
entries.expectedResult: Every username is redacted. No password, Authorization value, or Keychain secret is present.

entries.stage: Approved macOS network validation after ACE operations and Security approve the Preview endpoint and certificate
entries.procedure: Run controlled trust and hostname failure cases. Capture no credentials and make no bypass attempt.
entries.expectedResult: The secure-connection message appears. No request or authorization value reaches a rejected endpoint.

entries.stage: Approved macOS Xcode controlled build validation
entries.procedure: Run the existing build with missing and invalid approved Preview input values. Retain only fictional input values and build logs.
entries.expectedResult: The Validate Preview Inputs build phase rejects both missing and invalid origin input before compilation completes.

entries.procedure: Run make ui-test on the approved simulator. Capture normal screenshots with fictional release and sign-in values only. Review the captured images.
entries.expectedResult: Normal screenshots remain available. The sign-in screenshot shows only the permitted visible username field and no password.

entries.stage: Approved macOS simulator and server-record review after Security and Pocock approval
entries.procedure: Verify active and inactive callbacks, app-switcher cover timing, and the separate unchanged server compatibility record.
entries.expectedResult: SwiftUI content remains visible while active. The cover installs before inactive return and removes after activation. Server compatibility evidence remains separate and unchanged.
